.TH "NPM-INIT" "1" "March 2026" "NPM@10.9.7" ""
.SH "NAME"
\fBnpm-init\fR - Create a package.json file
.SS "Synopsis"
.P
.RS 2
.nf
npm init <package-spec> (same as `npx create-<package-spec>`)
npm init <@scope> (same as `npx <@scope>/create`)

aliases: create, innit
.fi
.RE
.SS "Description"
.P
\fBnpm init <initializer>\fR can be used to set up a new or existing npm package.
.P
\fBinitializer\fR in this case is an npm package named \fBcreate-<initializer>\fR, which will be installed by npm help
